housing: Loughborough, home to Loughborough University, has a large student rental market, with many Victorian terraces near the campus let as shared houses and a growing number of purpose-built student blocks. South of the borough, Birstall, Thurmaston and Syston are suburbs of Leicester with inter-war and post-war family homes. Shepshed and the villages around Charnwood Forest mix older stone and brick cottages with large new-build estates.
checkinTips: Student houses in Loughborough: photograph each bedroom's lock and door, fire doors, smoke alarms and the shared kitchen separately.
Victorian terraces near the town centre: check sash or replacement windows, rear extensions, back yards and any damp in cellars.
Furnished student lets: list and photograph every item of furniture, with mattress condition and fire labels, and note bins and recycling at check-out.
New-build estates in Shepshed and Syston: note snagging marks, sealant around baths and showers, and new garden fences.
Homes near the River Soar and its brooks: photograph ground floors and gardens for signs of damp or past flooding.
Stone cottages around Charnwood Forest: photograph beams, fireplaces, wood burners and any damp in thick walls.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems in a privately rented home can contact Charnwood Borough Council's private sector housing team.
